scripts.lint: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.lint-fix: uv run ruff check --fix . && uv run ruff format .
scripts.quality: devbox run lint && devbox run typecheck
scripts.secrets-baseline: grep -qs is_line_allowlisted .secrets.baseline.json || detect-secrets scan --exclude-files '\.lock$' --disable-filter detect_secrets.filters.gibberish.should_exclude_secret > .secrets.baseline.json; detect-secrets scan --baseline .secrets.baseline.json --exclude-files '\.lock$' --disable-filter detect_secrets.filters.gibberish.should_exclude_secret
scripts.security: devbox run audit && devbox run secrets-scan && devbox run bandit
scripts.ci: devbox run quality && devbox run test && devbox run security && if grep -qs '"ci-extra"[[:space:]]*:' devbox.json; then devbox run ci-extra; fi
scripts.image-smoke: docker rm -f todo-api-smoke >/dev/null 2>&1; docker run -d --name todo-api-smoke --read-only --tmpfs /tmp -e DATABASE_URL=${DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://smoke:smoke@127.0.0.1:5432/smoke} -p 18080:8080 todo-api:scan >/dev/null && sleep 6 && { curl -s -w ' /health=%{http_code}\n' localhost:18080/health || true; curl -s -w ' /ready=%{http_code}\n' localhost:18080/ready || true; docker logs todo-api-smoke 2>&1 | tail -5; docker inspect -f 'user={{.Config.User}}' todo-api-smoke; }; docker rm -f todo-api-smoke >/dev/null
